roadmap.name: Excel Fundamentals
roadmap.description: Mastering spreadsheet software is crucial for accounting. Learn basic formulas, data manipulation, and charting.

roadmap.name: Financial Statement Analysis
roadmap.description: Develop the ability to interpret and analyze balance sheets, income statements, and cash flow statements to assess a company's financial health.

roadmap.name: Accounting Principles
roadmap.description: Gain a deep understanding of Generally Accepted Accounting Principles (GAAP) and their application in various accounting scenarios.

roadmap.name: Become an Accountant
roadmap.description: Successfully pursue and obtain an accounting position, demonstrating proficiency in accounting principles and practices.

roadmap.name: Data Analysis Basics
roadmap.description: Learn fundamental data analysis techniques, including data cleaning, transformation, and visualization.

roadmap.name: Tax Law Fundamentals
roadmap.description: Understand the basics of tax laws and regulations, including income tax, sales tax, and property tax.

goals.name: Have more endurance
current_quests: Go for a run once a week

roadmap.name: Zone 2 Cardio
roadmap.description: Low-intensity steady-state exercise to build aerobic base and mitochondrial efficiency.

roadmap.name: Running Form
roadmap.description: Improve running technique for efficiency and injury prevention.

roadmap.name: Strength Training Basics
roadmap.description: Introduce fundamental strength training exercises to build a solid foundation.

roadmap.name: Recovery Strategies
roadmap.description: Learn techniques for muscle repair and reducing soreness.

roadmap.name: Endurance Progression
roadmap.description: Implement a structured plan for gradually increasing training volume and intensity.

roadmap.name: Increased Endurance
roadmap.description: Achieve a higher level of sustained physical performance.

goals.name: Be more in tune with myself
needed_quests: Be More In Tune With Myself

roadmap.name: Self-Awareness
roadmap.description: Understanding your own thoughts, feelings, and behaviors.

roadmap.name: Mindfulness Practice
roadmap.description: Regularly focusing on the present moment without judgment.

roadmap.name: Emotional Regulation
roadmap.description: Managing and responding to emotions in a healthy way.

roadmap.name: Cognitive Restructuring
roadmap.description: Identifying and challenging negative thought patterns.

roadmap.name: Be More In Tune With Myself
roadmap.description: Cultivating a deeper understanding of your inner self and values.

goals.name: Be able to talk to more people

roadmap.name: Active Listening
roadmap.description: Focus on truly understanding what others are saying, both verbally and nonverbally. Practice summarizing and asking clarifying questions.

roadmap.name: Empathy
roadmap.description: Develop the ability to understand and share the feelings of others. Consider their perspective and validate their emotions.

roadmap.name: Nonverbal Communication
roadmap.description: Learn to interpret and utilize body language, facial expressions, and tone of voice to enhance communication and build rapport.

roadmap.name: Rapport Building
roadmap.description: Techniques for establishing a connection with others, such as finding common ground, mirroring, and using positive language.

roadmap.name: Conversation Starters
roadmap.description: Learn a variety of open-ended questions and topics to initiate and maintain engaging conversations.

roadmap.name: Increase Social Interactions
roadmap.description: Proactively seek opportunities to interact with new people and strengthen existing relationships.  Set realistic goals and track progress.

nodes.name: Create a New Spreadsheet
nodes.description: Start with a blank spreadsheet and save it.

nodes.name: Enter 5 Data Points
nodes.description: Input 5 different values into a single cell.

nodes.name: Basic Formula - Sum
nodes.description: Enter a simple SUM formula in a cell.

nodes.name: Read 1 Article on Financial Statements
nodes.description: Find and read a short article explaining a financial statement.

nodes.name: Analyze a Simple Income Statement
nodes.description: Find a basic income statement and identify key figures.

nodes.name: Research a Company's Financials
nodes.description: Look up the financials of a publicly traded company.

nodes.name: Review One Accounting Principle
nodes.description: Read about a single accounting principle (e.g., matching principle).

nodes.name: Define Key Accounting Term
nodes.description: Write down the definition of a common accounting term.

nodes.name: Practice Journal Entry
nodes.description: Create a simple journal entry for a transaction.

nodes.name: Research Accountant Roles
nodes.description: Spend 15 minutes researching different types of accountant roles.

nodes.name: Update Resume
nodes.description: Add one relevant skill or experience to your resume.

nodes.name: Network with an Accountant
nodes.description: Reach out to an accountant on LinkedIn.

nodes.name: Learn a New Data Analysis Tool
nodes.description: Spend 30 minutes learning a new data analysis tool (e.g., Tableau, Power BI).

nodes.name: Analyze a Small Dataset
nodes.description: Find a small dataset and perform a basic analysis.

nodes.name: Practice Data Cleaning
nodes.description: Clean up a messy dataset.

nodes.name: Read a Tax Law Article
nodes.description: Read a short article about a specific tax law.

nodes.name: Understand Tax Forms
nodes.description: Review a common tax form (e.g., 1040).

nodes.name: Research Tax Deductions
nodes.description: Research a potential tax deduction.

nodes.name: Walk at a Conversational Pace
nodes.description: Go for a 30-minute walk at a pace where you can comfortably hold a conversation.

nodes.name: Cycle at a Moderate Intensity
nodes.description: Cycle for 45 minutes at a moderate intensity.

nodes.name: Increase Zone 2 Duration
nodes.description: Increase the duration of your Zone 2 cardio session by 10 minutes.

nodes.name: Record Running Form
nodes.description: Record yourself running and analyze your form.

nodes.name: Focus on Cadence
nodes.description: Pay attention to your foot strike and cadence.

nodes.name: Practice Arm Swing
nodes.description: Focus on a relaxed and efficient arm swing.

nodes.name: Bodyweight Squats
nodes.description: Perform 3 sets of 10 bodyweight squats.

nodes.name: Push-Ups
nodes.description: Perform 3 sets of as many push-ups as possible.

nodes.name: Learn a New Exercise
nodes.description: Research and learn a new basic strength training exercise.

nodes.name: Stretch for 15 Minutes
nodes.description: Stretch all major muscle groups for 15 minutes.

nodes.name: Hydrate with Electrolytes
nodes.description: Drink a beverage with electrolytes.

nodes.name: Foam Roll for 10 Minutes
nodes.description: Foam roll major muscle groups for 10 minutes.

nodes.name: Practice Endurance Progression for 10 minutes
nodes.description: Daily habit to improve Endurance Progression.

nodes.name: Practice Increased Endurance for 10 minutes
nodes.description: Daily habit to improve Increased Endurance.

nodes.description: Daily habit to improve Self-Awareness.

nodes.name: Meditate for 5 Minutes

nodes.name: Mindful Breathing

nodes.name: Identify an Emotion
nodes.description: Take 5 minutes to identify and name an emotion you're feeling.
